technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with massive volume spike present, but complete absence of bullish confirmation signals, price below all key moving averages, and negative momentum indicators suggest this is a capitulation washout rather than a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: PNW shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 48 days create near-term uncertainty.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-like 11 score) with 58% bearish AAII sentiment presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent congressional conviction and no recent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (406.4) with flat yield curve, FOMC event just passed, and utilities sector facing credit stress headwinds; 48-day earnings window adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9 and 14) combined with 15x volume spike and contrarian fear sentiment (58% bearish AAII) creates textbook capitulation setup for mean-reversion swing trade.
debate.key_bear_argument: Complete absence of bullish confirmation across all momentum indicators (MACD bearish, AO negative, Hull bearish, Ichimoku below cloud, OBV flat), price below all major moving averages, macro crisis regime (VIX 406.4), and 48-day earnings event risk make this a washout trap rather than a high-probability entry.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme RSI oversold (9/14) and 15x volume spike present textbook capitulation setup, complete absence of bullish confirmation across MACD, AO, Hull, Ichimoku, and OBV—combined with price below all major moving averages—indicates washout trap rather than reversal.
decision.primary_risk: Macro crisis regime (VIX 406.4) with flat yield curve and high credit spreads creates structural headwind; 48-day earnings event adds near-term uncertainty with no fundamental catalyst to support recovery.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, fundamental, and risk agents all signal weakness; only sentiment offers contrarian angle but insufficient to override structural bearishness
decision.portfolio_note: Already 10 positions in Utilities sector; adding PNW increases concentration risk in low-conviction, high-risk macro environment.
